The option "2:56 p.m." subtracts a single 4-minute loss, treating the rate as a one-off. The option "2:24 p.m." counts 9 hours rather than 6, reading the 9 in 9:00 a.m. as the number of hours that pass. The option "2:40 p.m." counts only 5 hours by counting the gaps between the six o'clocks from 10 to 3.
